Thanks again for the call today — great discussion and appreciate the level of detail you shared about FintechCo's fraud scoring flow. As a quick recap & to help us put together a tight hosted-API proposal, can you confirm the following so we can map to unit economics: 

1) Expected monthly token volume (rough ballpark is fine) — do you expect this to be steady or ramp across quarters?
2) Peak TPS (requests per second) at peak hour/day — is this sustained or brief bursts?
3) Budget range you're targeting for hosted inference (monthly)?
4) Target unit economics (e.g. $/1M tokens) that you'd need to make this a go/no-go decision?

If you can send a small sample of token distribution (or the CSV you mentioned on the call), that would help us size batching/prefix caching and give a more accurate cost estimate.

I'll pull Marissa in on the pricing side once we get those numbers. Happy to schedule a 30-minute follow-up later this week.

Laura —

This is really helpful, thanks. A few clarifying questions that will materially affect the hosted pricing model: 

- The 15 TPS sustained window: is that for individual scoring requests that are short (100-300 tokens/request), or for longer assistant-style interactions?
- For burst behavior up to 25 TPS, what is the expected burst duration (minutes)?
- Token mix: you mentioned ~10% assistant/chat — is the remaining 90% mostly short scoring calls (<=300 tokens) or a mix with some longer contexts?

High-level, with 30M tokens/month and a target ~$350/1M tokens, that maps to ~$10.5k/month raw token spend (30 * $350). That aligns with the middle of your stated budget range but doesn't include per-request overheads, cache/batching benefits, or discounts for committed volumes.

I've attached a draft hosted-API pricing sheet with two scenarios: 1) self-serve hosted plan with volume tiers, and 2) committed monthly program (3-12 month) that gets closer to your $/1M target. If you can share the CSV, we can run it through our batching/caching sim and come back with optimized unit economics (likely to improve the effective $/1M).

Next steps I propose:
- You upload the anonymized sample usage CSV to the Drive link (or send it directly).
- We run a quick sizing estimate (24-48h) and return a firm hosted-API quote and a 30-min review session.

Available for a sync Thu or next Tue afternoon - what works for you?

Thanks,

Hi Laura —

Looping in on pricing — happy to run the batching/caching sim once you upload the sample. A couple of notes on how we typically help customers hit the $/1M targets: 

- Committed monthly volume (6-12 months) usually unlocks the biggest unit-cost improvements.
- If the token mix is heavily short scoring calls, our automatic prefix/KV cache plus continuous batching can reduce effective per-token spend by 10-25% depending on hit rates.
- For predictable sustained TPS windows, we can propose a reserved-hosted configuration that stabilizes latency and further reduces cost compared to bursty pay-as-you-go.

If it helps, I'm available to join the review call and walk through the sim results.
